instructions:
Dreep stores, transforms and delivers images, videos, audio and documents.

- Upload with upload_file (a local path, or base64 content). The result's `url`
  is the delivery URL; always use URLs exactly as Dreep returns them, never
  build one by hand (projects can be on a custom CDN domain).
- To resize, crop, convert or compress, call build_delivery_url with a
  transform. Nothing is re-uploaded: the CDN transforms on the fly.
- For assets in signed folders, use build_signed_url.
- remove_background, extract_text (OCR) and convert_document each take a file.
- Folders and presets organise the project; get_usage reports storage.
- Delete tools exist only when the server sets DREEP_MCP_ALLOW_DELETE; deletes
  are permanent, so confirm with the user first.

tools.description:
Builds a delivery URL that resizes, crops, converts or otherwise transforms an asset.

Transforms run on the fly at the CDN and are cached. Example: width 400 and
format webp for a thumbnail; format pdf to convert a Word document.

tools.description:
Creates a folder. Uploads create folders on demand, so this is mainly for
setting access control before anything lands.

Access control can only be set on a top-level folder (name, no parent);
nested folders inherit it. Folders cannot be deleted through the API.

access_control_type.description: public, private or signed. Top-level folders only.
access_control_type.title: Access Control Type

path.description: Or create a whole chain, e.g. 'clients/acme/logos'.
path.title: Path

Starts a direct-to-storage upload for bytes this server can't read.

PUT the file to `upload_url` with exactly this Content-Type and Content-Length
(valid about ten minutes), then call confirm_upload with the returned `id`.
If `already_exists` is true, skip the PUT and confirm straight away.
